name: Audit a web page for AI answerability (GEO) from a form

parameters.formDescription: Scores how well one page can be used in AI answers (0 to 100) and lists what to fix. The audit takes up to a minute.

values.placeholder: Optional: a question this page should answer

nodes.name: Audit page for AI answerability

parameters.customBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ startUrls: [{ url: $json["Page URL"].trim() }], brandName: $json["Brand name"].trim(), targetPrompts: $json["Target question"] ? [$json["Target question"].trim()] : [], maxPages: 1 }) }}

nodes.notes: Runs the Apify Actor muhammadafzal/geo-content-auditor on the one URL from the form. About USD 0.05 per audited page; a page that fails to load is not charged. The node always outputs an item so the next node can route a failed audit.
